clause: GPU render-path wiring for effects: RenderEngine binding, EFFECT_GPU_UNAVAILABLE, CPU fallback promotion-equivalence, headless/quiet [STU-FX-036,STU-FX-038,STU-FX-018]

scope.summary: Wire every filter/effect through the studio-engine RenderEngine (wgpu/WGSL) driven by StudioRenderHarness: GPU-Req rows run on a supported backend or return a determinate EFFECT_GPU_UNAVAILABLE state (harness records shortfall, never silent empty output); Opt rows carry a CPU fallback producing promotion-equivalent output; GPU deps stay isolated in studio-engine (never in handshake_core Cargo.toml). Batch/model-driven application runs headless and quiet (14.20): no foreground window, no focus/input steal; interactive group-12 workspaces expose an equivalent headless typed-data path.
proof_targets: real-GPU render + headless EFFECT_GPU_UNAVAILABLE fallback + quiet negative test
expected_tests: real-GPU: GPU-Req effect renders through RenderEngine; headless fallback: no-GPU returns EFFECT_GPU_UNAVAILABLE (AccessKit-tree assert, not empty)
test: Opt effect CPU fallback promotion-equivalent to GPU within tolerance
negative: batch effect run pops no window / steals no focus; handshake_core Cargo.toml has no wgpu/wgsl
acceptance_criteria_original: RenderEngine/StudioRenderHarness binding; GPU-Req -> determinate unavailable state; Opt CPU fallback equivalent; GPU dep isolated; headless+quiet

spec_clauses.spec_clause_text: [STU-FX-036] Every filter/effect evaluates through the `studio-engine` `RenderEngine` (wgpu/WGSL), driven by the `StudioRenderHarness` primitive. Rows marked GPU `Req` MUST run on a supported GPU backend; when none is available the effect returns a determinate `EFFECT_GPU_UNAVAILABLE` state ([STU-FX-018]) rather than a silent empty result, and the harness records the shortfall. Rows marked `Opt` have a CPU fallback path in `studio-engine` that produces promotion-equivalent output. GPU dependencies stay isolated in `studio-engine` and never enter `handshake_core`'s `Cargo.toml` ([STU-ARC-002]).

[STU-FX-038] The effect engine runs headless and quiet (14.20): batch/model-driven effect application MUST NOT pop a foreground window, steal focus, or require an interactive workspace to complete; the interactive workspaces of group 12 expose an equivalent headless parameter path (constraint lines, planes, mesh points as typed data) so a model can apply them without the on-canvas UI. --- ### 19. Effect Styles, Presets & Reuse

[STU-FX-018] GPU-required render effects MUST declare their GPU dependency in the `StudioLiveFilter` descriptor so a headless/quiet run (14.20) and a no-GPU environment surface a determinate `EFFECT_GPU_UNAVAILABLE` result rather than silently producing empty output. | Studio effect | Targets | GPU | Behavior (normative) | |---|---|---|---| | Clouds | R | Opt | Random cloud pattern between two colors, replacing layer data (seeded). | | Difference Clouds | R | Opt | Blends generated clouds with existing pixels in Difference mode; marble-like on repeat (seeded). | | Fibers | R | Opt | Woven-fiber texture from two colors with variance, strength, randomize. | | Lens Flare | R | Opt | Simulated lens-refraction flare with placeable center and lens-type presets. | | Lighting Effects | R | Req | GPU lighting workspace: point/spot/infinite lights, per-light properties, and grayscale texture channels as bump maps. Dedup of the lighting render filter and the 3D-style lighting live filter. | | Flame | R | Req | Parameterized realistic flames rendered along a selected path onto a pixel layer; requires GPU + an active work path. | | Picture Frame | R | Req | Scripted decorative frame designs drawn around the canvas; requires GPU + a pixel layer. | | Tree | R | Req | Parameterized tree species with leaf/branch/light settings; requires GPU + a pixel layer. | | Procedural Texture (formula) | R | Opt | User-authored mathematical pixel-math formulas generate/transform pixels (scriptable generator surface, deterministic per inputs). | --- ### 8. Sharpen & Detail Family

[STU-ARC-002] `handshake_core`'s `Cargo.toml` MUST NOT gain `wgpu`, WGSL, or GPU-compute dependencies for Studio. All GPU/compute code is isolated in the `studio-engine` workspace crate and reached through the `RasterEngine`/`VectorEngine`/`LayoutEngine`/`TextEngine`/`ColorEngine`/`RenderEngine: Send + Sync` trait boundaries defined in `studio-engine/src/lib.rs` (mirrors [TAI-OVR-009]).

[STU-QUIET-001] HEADLESS BY LAW. Agent-driven Studio work MUST run headless (no visible window brought to foreground). It MUST NOT steal keyboard focus, hijack keyboard input, move or click the OS mouse/cursor, capture focus, or use attention-stealing desktop APIs (HBR-QUIET-001).

implementation_notes.naming: Vendor product names are provenance only. Studio ships Handshake-native names per [STU-SECTION-003].
implementation_notes.database: SurrealDB with the EventLedger is the only durable authority. SQLite, libSQL, Turso and PostgreSQL are forbidden, including in tests and dev caches.
implementation_notes.engine_split: GPU, WGSL and compute live in the studio-engine crate behind its traits. handshake_core must never gain a GPU dependency.
implementation_notes.routing: Navigation extends the existing address and bus seams. No new router.
implementation_notes.worktree: Code paths resolve against the WP-KERNEL-012 worktree, never main.

validator_focus: Confirm every acceptance row traces to a sentence in the cited spec clause carried in implementation_notes. A row with no spec basis is a fabrication.
Reject any row still carrying proof_target_status REQUIRED: it has no proof of its own.
Reject scaffold-only proof: at least one proof command must drive the executable runtime rather than a fixture the implementer authored.
Where the contract touches numeric parameters, confirm hard and soft bounds are stored as separate values and an unknown bound is stored as unknown, never mirrored.
